div.div:
Draft 2026-11-11
Sources: DAQ VD Fiber Plant v3; "VD onDetector Rack View of Cabling" (TMS, stamped 16SEPT2026); "VD Cryostat 27U Detector Racks" naming drawing (20 N + 20 S racks); "DAQ Readout Network" PRR specification (EDMS 3463072, v1.0, 21 May 2026).
Open items
1. Purchase ownership assumed by analogy with TDE and PDS, not confirmed: BDE buys the WIEC electronics, the MTP12 pigtails to the 27U patch panel, the RJ45 Cu cables and the timing fibers from the PTCs to the splitter; racks and the patch cord from the 1G switch to the 27U patch panel are FDC I&I.
2. The patching between the trunk patch panel and the readout switches (top-of-rack patch panels, MTP-12 into 4-way breakout transceivers, per EDMS 3463072) is not drawn in detail.
3. DTS fanout rack on the cryostat roof: rack name and location, fanout hardware, number of fibers from the DTS master and its Ctrl network connection are not defined here.
4. The 1G ports for the CRP level meter and the DPS PDU on the TMS sheet ("2x1G DPS" in the VD overview) are not drawn here.
5. Two 10G Ctrl uplinks per 27U rack are assumed.
6. Follow-up: who purchases the 2xLC patch cord from the DAQ barracks patch panel to the Ctrl network switch (drawn as DAQ).
